methods.label: Track the faces as the net folds
methods.explanation:
Hold the square labeled \(V\) as the front face of the cube. Fold \(U\) and \(W\) backward along their shared edges with \(V\); they become the left and right faces. Fold \(X\) backward along the bottom edge of \(V\), making \(X\) the bottom face.

The square \(Y\) is attached to the upper edge of \(W\). Once \(W\) is the right face, \(Y\) folds across the top of the cube. The remaining square \(Z\), attached beyond \(X\), closes the back. Thus \(X\) is the bottom and \(Y\) is the top, so the face opposite \(X\) is \(\boxed{Y}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
